ai.title: Report purchased credit usage to Stripe metering
ai.summary: Added stripe-metering.ts to report purchased credit consumption to Stripe billing meter events. consumeCredits and consumeCreditsAndAddAgentStep now trigger reporting after successful transactions. User contract adds stripe_customer_id column; API handlers propagate it to credit consumption. Metering skipped in CI/test or when Stripe key missing; uses idempotency keys for message-based events.

eli5.text: When you use purchased credits towards a service, the system now tells Stripe (the payments processor) that those credits were used, so your billing stays accurate. This applies right away: any credit consumption that happens through the chat APIs now reports back to Stripe after the transaction succeeds, and your account now stores a link to your Stripe customer record. Behind the scenes, the system avoids sending these reports during automated testing or when Stripe isn't fully set up, and it uses a unique key per message so the same usage isn't counted twice.

ai.title: Cache Stripe loader, typed test fixtures, Playwright output dirs
ai.summary: Billing setup page hoists loadStripe to module scope for cached promise reuse. Test agent runtime fixture getUserInfoFromApiKey now generic over UserColumn fields, filtering response. Playwright config adds outputDir and reporter outputFolder paths. Comments document inline require rationale in clipboard, local-agent-registry, model-utils.

eli5.text: When you visit the billing setup page to enter your payment method, the page now loads Stripe (the payment processor) once when the page first opens, instead of reloading it every time you click to pay. This means the payment screen should open a bit faster since the Stripe setup work is already done and waiting for you. The change affects anyone setting up billing on the web app and is live today.
